purpose: Analyse verified historical 15-E papers to identify recurring concepts, constructions and chapter/question-type patterns without treating historical frequency as current blueprint weightage.

priority_model.high: recurs across multiple years/paper types and remains compatible with 2026-27 blueprint
priority_model.medium: recurs or represents a useful KSEAB construction
priority_model.low: limited historical evidence but useful for coverage

guardrails: historical frequency never overrides official 2026-27 blueprint
mid-term papers are supporting evidence only
avoid unnecessary verbatim duplication in original practice questions
